title: Source-invariant mediator response-surface gate
purpose: Strengthen the pairwise interface-equivalence design by requiring multiple matched mediator zones across independent source families and an orthogonal interface reference, so a shared mechanism candidate is supported only if source families collapse onto one reproducible mediator-to-BC response surface.
central_claim_boundary: A response-surface collapse can support a source-invariant mediator model within the tested domain. It does not prove a universal biological law, complete causal mediation, or material memory.

mediator_target_zones.definition: lowest preregistered nonzero interface-state displacement from baseline that is reliably distinguishable from technical noise
highest preregistered interface-state displacement compatible with stability, feasibility and the non-destructive calibration boundary

zone_freeze_rule: Z1/Z2/Z3 target vectors and their matching tolerances are defined from Stage-A abiotic calibration and technical repeatability before any response-surface BC outcomes are inspected.

design_logic.within_zone_question: At the same mediator target zone, are BC outcomes equivalent across distinct source families within a preregistered BC equivalence margin?
design_logic.between_zone_question: Across Z1/Z2/Z3, does BC phenotype change reproducibly with mediator state rather than remaining flat?
design_logic.orthogonal_reference_question: Does the non-nutritional interface reference fall on the same zone-to-BC relation as the biological proteins/interface model?
design_logic.holdout_question: On a fully independent batch, does a source-blind mediator model predict BC as well as a source-aware model within a preregistered predictive tolerance?

model_comparison_gate.source_aware_model: Y_BC = f(MEDIATOR_VECTOR, measured_generic_covariates, batch structure) + SOURCE_FAMILY and preregistered source interactions
model_comparison_gate.model_family_freeze: The functional basis, regularization/complexity rule, held-out batch definition and predictive tolerance must be frozen before outcome comparison.
model_comparison_gate.interpretation: If source-aware information materially improves held-out prediction, source-invariant mediation is not established even if some matched pairs look similar.

decision_rules.if: one or more required source families cannot be matched into the preregistered mediator zones
cross-family equivalence passes in only one zone
mediator zones differ measurably but BC response is reproducibly flat
within-zone equivalence fails reproducibly or source-aware holdout prediction materially outperforms source-blind prediction
biological protein families collapse but the orthogonal non-nutritional interface reference does not
all required collapse, gradient, orthogonal-reference, replication and held-out prediction gates pass

causal_ceiling_after_R5: R5 supports source-invariant mediation within the tested domain but does not by itself prove full necessity. A later compensatory or orthogonal intervention that changes the mediator while the source factor is held fixed is required for stronger causal mediation language.

future_necessity_gate.question: When a candidate source factor is held present, can an independent compensatory intervention restore the mediator vector toward baseline and correspondingly attenuate the BC phenotype without introducing a new dominant mechanism?
future_necessity_gate.warning: Compensatory mixtures can create new interactions; any necessity experiment requires its own controls and preregistration.

material_memory_gate.reason: Neither pairwise equivalence nor response-surface collapse establishes a persistent spatial record of a transient biological state.

kill_rules: Same phenotype at one matched point is not a common mechanism.
No common response surface without all preregistered mediator zones.
No interface-mediation claim if the orthogonal non-nutritional interface reference fails to track the relation.
No source-invariant claim if source-aware information materially improves held-out prediction.
No universal-law wording from a finite tested domain.
No causal-necessity wording before the future necessity gate.
No material-memory wording before a transient pulse leaves a spatially persistent record.
next_gate: CALIBRATE Z1/Z2/Z3 FOR EACH SOURCE FAMILY WITHOUT BC OUTCOME FEEDBACK; FREEZE RESPONSE-SURFACE ANALYSIS AND HELD-OUT BATCH; THEN RUN MULTI_ZONE BC CHALLENGE.
